ns2:course.label: Hindsley Symphonic Band
ns2:course.description: Maintains the instrumentation of a standard concert band. The literature studied and performed is of the highest caliber and technical difficulty. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of each course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public performances by the band. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
